findings: Historical MAXfragment overlap is clipped before each cutoff. WARP reads no forecast labels.
Count positives are binarized; only historically observed users and items enter WARP training, excluding future-only IDs from negative sampling.
No seen-item exclusion; repeated programmes remain candidates.
Cold entity pairs receive six deterministic zero scalar features plus independent cold-user/item flags. Their random initialized embeddings do not enter ranking features.
Score, percentile, biases and L2 norms require no latent-coordinate alignment. Full observed future-pool percentile uses stable numeric ID ties and does not condition on shortlist relevance.
Original24 feature input hashes match v3 exactly. Row-wise historical count30 matches sparse collaborative counts exactly across all windows.
Same top5 full-universe labels and complete query filtering are used by fixed417/config1 refit; one prescribed primary, no candidate expansion.
Seen/unseen AP credits retain full truth denominator and sum to ordinary MAP. Bootstrap intervals explicitly conditional on fixed models and reused cohorts.
risks: Raw score/bias/norm scales may shift across independent cutoff-specific fits despite rotational invariance; percentile is more comparable. This is a modeling uncertainty, not leakage.
Two-thread WARP updates may be nondeterministic despite fixed seed; protocol acknowledges this.
Actual WARP fit outputs and cold-zero assertions still require successful builder execution; this review did not train or import LightFM.
